plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for MPB Communications 2RU optical amplifiers (enterprise PEN 4464, MPBC-2RU-MIB). Besides standard IF-MIB interface traffic and uptime, it reports case and pump-laser temperatures, optical input and output power, gain and the unit state.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Case temperature of the MPB Communications 2RU optical amplifier in degrees Celsius, from MPBC-2RU-MIB mpbc2RUPxxCaseTempDegCx10 (1.3.6.1.4.1.4464.2.2.2.2.7, 0.1 C) divided by 10 in the collector. Values outside -40 to 125 C are dropped.

metrics.name: mpb_ld1_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Pump laser 1 temperature of the MPB 2RU amplifier in degrees Celsius, from MPBC-2RU-MIB mpbc2RUPxxLD1TempDegCx10 (1.3.6.1.4.1.4464.2.2.2.2.2, 0.1 C) divided by 10 in the collector. Values outside -40 to 125 C are dropped.

metrics.name: mpb_ld2_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Pump laser 2 temperature of the MPB 2RU amplifier in degrees Celsius, from MPBC-2RU-MIB mpbc2RUPxxLD2TempDegCx10 (1.3.6.1.4.1.4464.2.2.2.2.5, 0.1 C) divided by 10 in the collector. Values outside -40 to 125 C are dropped.

metrics.name: mpb_output_power_mw
metrics.description: Optical output power of the MPB 2RU amplifier in milliwatts, from MPBC-2RU-MIB mpbc2RUPxxOutputPwrmW (1.3.6.1.4.1.4464.2.2.2.2.8). Values above 100000 mW or the 4294967295 sentinel are dropped.

metrics.name: mpb_input_power_mw
metrics.description: Optical input power of the MPB 2RU amplifier in milliwatts, from MPBC-2RU-MIB mpbc2RUPxxInputPwrmWx100 (1.3.6.1.4.1.4464.2.2.2.2.10, 0.01 mW) divided by 100 in the collector. The 4294967295 sentinel is dropped.

metrics.name: mpb_gain_db
metrics.description: Optical gain of the MPB 2RU amplifier in dB, from MPBC-2RU-MIB mpbc2RUPxxGaindBx10 (1.3.6.1.4.1.4464.2.2.2.2.9, 0.1 dB) divided by 10 in the collector. Values outside -10 to 60 dB are dropped.

metrics.name: mpb_unit_state
metrics.description: Unit state of the MPB 2RU amplifier from MPBC-2RU-MIB mpbc2RUPxxUnitState (1.3.6.1.4.1.4464.2.2.2.2.16). stateNormal(1) maps to 1 (normal); stateInit(0) and stateFault(2) map to 2 (abnormal). Values outside 0-2 are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
